Subject: Staging enclave validation: ownership & evidence needed

Hi Markus,

Thanks for onboarding Novaris to Redwood Private — we're excited to get the staging enclave wired and validated next week. Before we lock dates, the Security and Platform teams need a compact list of owners and evidence artifacts we can review during the smoke validation. Can you confirm the internal owners and what we should expect to receive from Redwood for the staging handoff?

What Novaris can provide from our side:
- Completed network diagram (attached)
- List of service account emails and initial ACLs
- Rack/cage contact for any on-prem coordination

What we need from Redwood for the staging test:
1) Enclave owner and escalation contact for each SLO bucket (network, KMS, telemetry).
2) A short checklist of network-level smoke tests (IP allowlist, egress, DNS resolution) and how they will be executed.
3) Any temporary cert/cert chain exchange plan for mutual TLS during staging.
4) Evidence artifacts: test results, connectivity logs, and a signed acceptance form.

We'd like to run the validation window Tue 26 May 09:00–12:00 PT. If that's feasible please also attach sample evidence files you will produce so our auditors can pre-review.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Liu
Head of Platform Operations
Novaris Health

Sara — thanks for the clear list and for the diagram. We can support the Tue 26 May window; below is the ownership matrix and the artifacts Redwood will provide during the staging handoff.

Ownership (primary / escalation):
- Network & connectivity: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.com) / Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com)
- KMS & key exchange: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) / Markus Klein (markus_klein@redwood.com)
- Telemetry & evidence collection: Ben Carter / Monica Patel

Enclave staging checklist (what Redwood will run):
- IP & CIDR verification: ensure Novaris CIDRs resolve and are routable to staging gateway
- TCP port smoke: 443, 9411 (tracing), 8125 (metrics) from Novaris bastion to staging endpoint
- Egress verification: outbound connections to our telemetry collector and model download bucket
- DNS + mTLS: validate service DNS entries and handshake with provided certs
- KV cache warmup and a single-request end-to-end generation smoke test

Evidence artifacts Redwood will deliver (post-window):
- Connectivity test results (CSV) with successful/failed port checks
- Traceroute + DNS resolution logs for sample flows
- TLS handshake logs (timestamped) and deployed cert thumbprints
- Telemetry snapshot (ingestion counts, sample latency traces)
- Signed handoff form (PDF) and a brief runbook excerpt (XLSX) for your ops team

Attachments: redwood-onboard-checklist.xlsx (checklist + runbook excerpt), access-roles.csv (template for roles we'll request)

If the schedule looks good, Monica will send the exact pre-flight commands and a small script you can run from your bastion to collect client-side logs. Ben and Karthik — please confirm you can own telemetry and kms artifacts respectively.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Success (Private)
Redwood Inference

Quick operational notes / preflight commands — Novaris team, please run these from your bastion before Tue's window and paste outputs into the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.com/private-onboard/NB-6421-evidence

Preflight checklist (one-line commands):
- Validate route:
  curl -sS -m 5 https://staging-e.{{novaris_domain}}/health || echo ROUTE_FAIL
- Port checks (run from bastion):
  nc -vz staging-e.{{novaris_domain}} 443 && nc -vz staging-e.{{novaris_domain}} 9411
- DNS resolution:
  dig +short staging-e.{{novaris_domain}} || echo DNS_FAIL
- TLS handshake sample (openssl):
  openssl s_client -connect staging-e.{{novaris_domain}}:443 -servername staging-e.{{novaris_domain}} -showcerts < /dev/null | sed -n '1,120p'

What I'll collect on my side during the window:
- Active traceroutes for failed flows
- Server-side connection logs and TLS thumbprints
- A single parallel run of our end-to-end smoke test (3 requests, capture latency & token counts)

Ben — I will need the telemetry snapshot (aggregated) and the signed handoff form by Wed 27 May EOD so Novaris can file with their compliance team.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Thanks — schedule confirmed for Tue 26 May 09:00–12:00 PT. I've uploaded our signed network diagram and the initial ACL list to the shared doc (link below). A couple of quick clarifications before we start:

1) Cert exchange: Novaris will provision a short-lived mTLS cert pair and share via the secure transfer link you provided. We expect the cert chain to be preloaded; please confirm where you will accept the PEMs (S3 URI or SFTP).
